ast_and_static_coverage.method_limit: AST parse checks syntax only: no imports, dynamic behavior, tensor shapes, data, or runtime semantics are validated.
ast_and_static_coverage.safe_yaml_count: 95 unique regular YAML/YML files safely parsed in project-wide configuration inventory; archive-only YAML members are listed and structurally inspected.

coverage_conclusion.scope_limit: Zero unread applies to the frozen self-owned model/loss/train/evaluate/inference and directly imported data/geometry/decision/support candidates: 43 protocol-named code SHA, the 29 SHA independent supplemental core/support list, the four unique Nextlib sources plus three same-SHA inherited aliases, and the previously listed non-protocol core and archive-only core versions. It does not claim manual full reading of all 1,146 regular source-code SHA. Generic utilities, third-party/vendor sources and 19 archive-only AST/index entries remain classified separately; AST syntax parsing is not semantic source review.
